description.en: The Bot team every Automagik product builds on, and the welcome that connects your AI.

title.en: Personal use under the vendor's terms

description.en: A team of long-lived Bots in DSH: the Main Bot and its Bots, group chats, memory and settings. Omni's channels and canvases build on it. Keeps its files in ~/.automagik/bots, never in your DSH profile. Formerly @automagik/omni-dsh (Omni team).

The octopus welcomes you, puts your team together and connects your AI: DeepSeek, an API key, Codex, Claude, Kimi or a CLIProxyAPI gateway, through DSH's own sign-ins. Formerly @automagik/omni-ai-dsh.
Genie joins your Bot team and grants wishes: each wish is a Task that works in its own git worktree of your project and commits the result on a wish/… branch. Needs the Bot team and git.

Sign in with the AI plans you already pay for, several accounts each: Antigravity, Cursor, Kiro, GLM, Qwen, ERNIE, Spark, JetBrains AI, Perplexity, Replit and Cody. Automagik's reviewed fork of GooDAnDReaDY's plugin, without the vendors DSH's own sign-ins already cover and without its own updater.

Brazilian Portuguese for DSH: the Bot team's own strings, under DSH's own Portuguese entry. Adds no language of its own, so Settings › General › Language keeps one Portuguese row; a pt-BR choice saved by an older pack moves to DSH's pt. Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2 or later.

Agents other than DSH's own as DSH models, over the Agent Client Protocol. A chat on one keeps DSH's history and sidebar; the agent's tool calls show as DSH tool cards and ask through DSH's approval dialog.
